premium.basis: 112.3% over the pre-Novo announcement price (stated in rationale)

value_inflection_events.event: Novo Nordisk public disclosure of rejected bid; Ablynx confirms rejection and J.P. Morgan contacts other parties

leaked_early.details: Novo Nordisk publicly disclosed its bid on 2018-01-08, 21 days before the Sanofi announcement; no evidence of a leak >1 month prior.

notes: Deal was triggered by an unsolicited Novo Nordisk bid that was rejected and then made public, prompting a targeted outreach to 8 other parties including Sanofi, which had an existing collaboration. The final €45.00 cash offer represented a significant jump from Novo's €28.00+CVR proposal.
